criteria.evidence: lineage-panel.svelte offers Compare with source on every run with forkedFrom and reads weft.workflows.compare for the run's own id alone, with no session state; lineage-panel.test.ts 'a fork opens its comparison from its own id alone' and 'a run that is not a fork has no compare action' pass. The reload and new-session path is tests/e2e/fork-comparison.spec.ts, written and not run on this host. Owner, 2026-11-22: run-page panels mount on workflow runs (a fork's run page also shows the run comparison card; see COR-2544).

fork-comparison-data.ts fetchForkComparison reads weft.workflows.compare and follows nextCursor (fork-comparison.test.ts); divergence.ts, divergence-view.svelte, run-step-timeline-selection.ts and their tests are deleted, so the browser aligns nothing; the Checkpoints tab shows the same server comparison after a fork.

fork-comparison.test.ts 'selecting a changed step shows its output difference in the diff viewer' reads the JsonDiffViewer group 'Output differences, step 2' and the changed id 1 -> 2; non-JSON summaries are read as text (parseSummary, tested in packages/interborough-plugin run-comparison.test.ts).

fork-comparison.test.ts 'shows the shared steps collapsed and the steps the fork ran again': the shared step is absent until the '1 step shared with the source' disclosure opens; fork-comparison.spec.ts asserts aria-expanded false and no [data-shared-step] before it is opened (spec not run here).

fork-dialog.test.ts 'ForkDialog fork preview (COR-2538)': kept and re-run steps from weft.workflows.fork with dryRun, Create fork disabled until the answer lands, a new request and no stale answer when the step or the typed revision changes, a refused preview framed as the revision conflict with Create fork disabled, nothing asked for a non-number or without workflows:write. tests/fixture-seed.test.ts pins on a real engine that the dry run for the fork spec's candidate revision is refused with WorkflowRevisionUnavailableError reason 'not-registered', and that the newest checkpoint keeps one step and reruns one.

tests/e2e/fork-comparison.spec.ts forks the seeded fork-comparison run from the first checkpoint row, reloads on the fork, opens the comparison from the lineage panel and reads the changed ticket in the diff viewer. NOT RUN: browser suites are barred on this host; the premise is proven on a real engine by tests/fixture-seed.test.ts. The design-review capture states are in tests/e2e/fork-comparison-states.spec.ts (also not run here).
